issues.on_page: 2610 Operations of buildings 378,119 / 2620 Maintenance of buildings 361,815 (O&M lines 2610-2650 total 847,807); statement p4 O&M 732,748 = 847,807 + Depreciation capital outlay 84,941 - 200,000
issues.issue: A 200,000 General Fund to Depreciation Fund transfer is embedded in the General Fund O&M expenditure lines (detail[72]-[73]) while the same 200,000 is also recorded as 'Transfer from the General Fund' other financing in detail[92]. Rule (transfers hidden inside spending lines) requires splitting it out as an other financing item with split_from + review; the same money currently appears as both spending and a transfer. The extractor noted it and added review but did not split. The page doesn't show which O&M line holds the 200,000, so a human needs to decide where the split goes.
